sidebar_description.edit_metadata_hint: To add a description and summary for this {{viewType}} click on the <icon/> icon in the search bar to open its action menu. The action menu includes the option "Edit metadata".

sidebar_create.info: Use the following options to add an aggregation, log view (enterprise feature) or parameters (enterprise feature) to your search.

sidebar_highlighting.description:
Search terms and field values can be highlighted. Highlighting your search query in the results can be enabled/disabled in the {{productName}} server config. Any field value can be highlighted by clicking on the value and selecting "Highlight this value".
If a term or a value has more than one rule, the first matching rule is used.
